page.overview:
Who is Muru?

Muru is a minor character in the Tekken Saga comic. While Kazuya was training in the forest in Japan, he was kicking down trees. This outraged the Manji Clan and one of its members, Muru, confronted Kazuya. Kazuya retaliated by smacking him across the face, knocking him unconscious.
